nodes.bodyHTML:
Pull request overview

This PR focuses on cleaning up verification/build warnings across the Verus-enabled memory-management code and the verified_bitflags macro, including adding missing SMT triggers, marking APIs as unsafe where required, and addressing a rustdoc-related build issue.

Changes:

  • Update verified_bitflags! to treat the flags field as ghost state and adjust construction to avoid doc-build failures.
  • Add explicit #![trigger ...] annotations to help the verifier discharge quantified assertions.
  • Mark metadata-slot mutation/drop helpers as unsafe to align with their safety preconditions.

Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

File Description
verified_bitflags/src/lib.rs Marks flags as a ghost field and adjusts flag construction to support doc/non-ghost builds.
ostd/src/mm/page_table/cursor/mod.rs Adds a missing trigger for a quantified assertion over mappings.
ostd/src/mm/frame/meta.rs Marks metadata write/drop helpers as unsafe to reflect required caller invariants.
ostd/src/mm/frame/linked_list.rs Adds missing triggers for quantified assertions over slot_owners.

review_comments.body: `Clone::clone` constructs the `flags` field using an unqualified `Ghost(...)` constructor and calls `flags_from_bits` unconditionally. Because this macro expands in downstream crates, `Ghost` may not be in scope at the invocation site, and the unconditional `flags_from_bits` use can reintroduce the doc/non-`verus_keep_ghost` build failure that `from_bits_unchecked` is already guarding against. Prefer fully-qualified `::vstd::prelude::Ghost` and mirror the same cfg-gated initialization used in `from_bits_unchecked`.
